sections.name: goal
sections.value: Ship pij procedures (PRD 005): settle the design in workshop 003, build the schema, runner and checks, write the first procedures, teach the skill, then review with osk-central's prime.

value.title: Workshop 003: settle PRD 005's open questions with the operator
value.done_when: Every PRD 005 open question is answered or carries an accepted default, and the PRD is amended to match.

value.title: Blueprint: how procedures are built
value.done_when: A blueprint realises every PRD 005 requirement with a component, and states the runner's cost (req-28).
value.note: Claim its number with `pij claim blueprint --for procedures`. Steps s03 to s05 gain their `builds` once it exists.

value.title: Schema, layout, id booking and the scaffold command
value.done_when: `pij/procedure` validates a complete procedure; `pij claim procedure` books ids; the scaffold creates a valid folder from a feature worktree, refuses on main, and works from any directory.

value.title: The runner: steps, preconditions, progress and flags
value.done_when: A three-step trial procedure shows idempotent steps, a refusing precondition with its fix, an order check across procedures, per-key progress, flags passed through and a long-running command outside the steps.

value.title: Links, drift check, generated list and status
value.done_when: `harness checks` fails on a broken link, a missing recipe or a misplaced file; the list is generated; a status change records the operator's yes; the spawn counter doesn't move while listing or checking.

value.title: Exemplars: the meta procedure and pij's first procedures
value.done_when: PROC-meta-0001 and the four first procedures are current, each run end to end by a fresh seat from the procedure alone.
value.note: The first is docs/how/change-seat-effort.md (branch docs/change-seat-effort), moved into a procedure folder.

value.title: Update the pij skill
value.done_when: The skill, packets and AGENTS.md carry the rule and point at procedures; the project-doc how-tos are PROC-docs procedures; the schema ships in the skill.

value.title: Review with osk-central's prime
value.done_when: pij-ultimate-scallop (or osk-central's current prime) has reviewed the shipped system against its fleet's experience, and its findings are folded into PRD 005 or answered.

value.change: First draft, in the operator's order: PRD, workshop, exemplars, skill, review with osk-central's prime.
